TutoExplainContent: Welcome to Connect 4. Take turns dropping discs into the board. The first player to line up four discs horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins!
TutoBoardContent: Click or tap a column to drop your disc. It falls to the lowest free place in that column.
TutoNetworkContent: Click here to share the activity so another user on the network can play with you
TutoModeContent: Switch between playing against the computer and playing with two players on the same screen
TutoRestartContent: Click here to clear the board and start a new game
